user_reported_bug: I had a possibility of rearranging the products and categories by mouse drag, rather than giving order number. Secondly, I don't want the section which is [category pills strip on the shop page].
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused backend and UI verification passed: admin Products/Categories/Subcategories support drag-and-drop reorder with persisted order and no manual Order field in Category/Subcategory drawers; /shop and /shop/drinkware no longer render the horizontal category pills strip while filters, subcategory Browse by type, product grid, breadcrumbs, and category navigation continue to work.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary QA subcategories only when needed to verify subcategory drag reorder; each temp record was deleted and original ordering was restored. Verified Drinkware/Mugs still exists with product_count=1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend script verified auth protection and persistence for category/subcategory/product reorder endpoints, restoring original order after mutations. Browser script authenticated via session_token cookie, verified storefront pill-strip removal, filters/subcategory strip, navbar/filter navigation, admin drag handles/draggable attrs, drag-drop persistence with reload, product search disables drag, and absence of manual Order fields. No MOCKED APIs were used in the tested reorder/shop flows.
rca_of_the_issue: Direct proof collected: POST reorder endpoints update order/display_order and public GETs return the new order; UI native drag/drop triggers Order saved toasts and persisted order survives reload; the removed category pills strip is absent on both /shop and /shop/drinkware, with only the intended subcategory strip and filter drawer remaining. No user-visible symptoms reproduced.
